comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Thanks for the heads up. There does indeed appear to be a schedule for railroad events, listed under "Schedule" appropriately enough:

gvo.gamedb.info/wiki/?TranscontinentalRailroad

So far GAMA seems to be perfectly in sync with the described events, right down to the original dates. Presumably the cycle repeats once a month. I mentioned previously not seeing some items for sale along with the Bonanza boxes; turns out they're future content, so all is checking out nicely on that front as well. (Can't edit old posts, so I'm deleting/re-posting instead. Sorry for the mess.)

Thanks again. Cheers, and here's to the completion of the Rare Items Travelled by Train Memorial Album (which the Feathered Tunic is a part of).
